notes: Harvest cap 7.00 MJ binds; periodicity restored with multiplier 1.172e-07 s/J after 11 DP solves.
measured_note: Reconstructed from the measured speed trace by inverse dynamics under the fitted model: the electrical power the observed acceleration required beyond the engine, and the recoverable share of the observed braking. Not a measurement — public telemetry has no energy channels — and it inherits the model's assumed engine power.
baseline_statement: Gain is measured against uniform constant deployment at the same starting state of charge, both strategies required to end the lap with at least the energy they started with.
harvest_cap_basis: 7 MJ qualifying-session cap (2026). SECONDARY source — not confirmed against an FIA document. The 8.5 MJ figure in Art. 5.4.10 is the race cap.
